items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: The only thing that stood out in my mind was it was such a big band they had there and then the three of us.

ctx.x: What else do you remember about the broadcast with Paul Whiteman.

-- The only thing that stood out in my mind was it was such a big band they had there and then the three of us. To me it was competitive, in a way of speaking... I said 'bt ga, "Look at all these guys -- violins & things & harps," I say "just do the best we can." Well, we were never a nervous group. We wea went to play we just played. I just had a harder time than anyone else. Cause trying to play 4 string
guitar and keep up with him is no picnic.
